Package com.sandy.sconsole.ai

Interface JobListener<P,R>

Type Parameters:
P - the app's payload type
R - the app's result type
public interface JobListener<P,R>
Follows one job through the hub. Calls come on the hub's worker threads, one at a time per job, in this order: started(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>) once, then per attempt attemptStarted(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.Attempt), check(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.Attempt, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AIReply) (if a reply came) and attemptFinished(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AttemptResult), and finally exactly one of succeeded(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, R, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.config.ModelInfo, boolean), failed(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, java.lang.String, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.FailureKind) or dropped(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>). Implementations must be thread-safe across jobs. An exception thrown by a callback is logged and otherwise ignored (check(com.sandy.sconsole.ai.JobContext<P>, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.Attempt, com.sandy.sconsole.ai.AIReply) throwing rejects the reply).
